title: Wanderer's Toolkit
description: A GM kit for D&D 5e. Hex travel with pace and encounter rolls, a flight-master network, a quest log (players read their quests in journals; the full data stays in a GM-only store), a character pane, boss frames, Need / Greed loot rolls, vendor-trash loot, a three-coin economy, inns and rest, map pins, zone title cards, a Table Tools section in scene settings, a health report, and migrations that bring older worlds forward. Every tool can be switched on or off per world. Your campaign content stays in your world.

recommends.reason: Vendor Trash and Boss loot turn defeated creatures into lootable piles; Loot rolls hand out items from piles with Need / Greed / Pass; Open shop for players opens its merchants on players' screens.
The Loot history window can group loot rolls by the Red Book's sessions (otherwise by date).
Sets Item Piles up for dnd5e, which Vendor Trash's lootable piles need.
